device_offline.title: {device_name} is offline from the Jackery cloud
device_offline.description:
The Jackery cloud has reported **{device_name}** as disconnected since {offline_since}. Its entities are unavailable until it reconnects.

Some Jackery stations do not reconnect on their own after an internet outage. To restore the connection, re-enable Wi-Fi on the device and re-add it in the Jackery app. This issue clears automatically once the device is back online.
